summary: The maintained organization-v4 inspect CLI accepts one bounded ephemeral integrator-stdin document, with explicit supplier/time/expiry/evidence and exact binding, enrollment, native issue/body, protected plan and PR revision joins. Caller-reported action, accountable-parent intake, remaining-after-active capacity and original-reservation facts are not authenticated native authority. Current deliverable links are discovery hints joined directly to native PR identity/state/head and complete open inventories; historical links do not establish acceptance. Integrator-ordered per-slice selection consumes only selected work, preserves exact existing-work continuation and original uncertain holds, and localizes relevant repository gaps while retaining genuine global gaps. Native repository policy/issue-author allowance is distinct from parent operation authority. Inspection disables disk cache IO and uses a fresh final Gate per item to detect policy or same-author permission changes through the existing bounded transport; a nonpersistent Gate alone still has an in-memory cache and is insufficient for that barrier. Missing, stale, conflicting or changed facts withhold selection. Reports grant no dispatch authority; determining native/runtime facts require fresh recomputation beside execution. The v4 Observation-only writer reuses source rechecks, Verified no-op checks, one dispatch, independent readback and no uncertain-response retry; it does not use selection/capacity or write human Status/Track/Roadmap. Product binding3/schema1 remains separate. Source controls require hosted build and coherent qualification; this capture proves neither installed composition, admitted Project3 migration, actual UI nor real-use adoption. Original .103/.104 operations remain unreplayed/held. The sole owning plan retains later canonical retirement of organization V1 intake/Class/legacy-phase/scheduling-ledger guidance and its mirrored/generated/package consumers in .11, preserving product contracts and user changes.
title: Programme inspection joins attributed caller observations to current native evidence
